subject: mm: tmpfs: huge=always Kconfig help understates severe space amplification

reviews.author: Dmitry Ilvokhin
reviews.summary: Suggested revising tmpfs huge=always Kconfig documentation to accurately reflect potential space amplification, particularly for workloads creating large numbers of small files.

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with Dmitry's suggestion to revise the documentation, but also pointed out that the shmem unused shrinker should try reclaiming THPs beyond EOF during memory pressure.

2026-11-02.patch_summary: tmpfs huge=always Kconfig documentation understates severe space amplification
